'''Trikking The Blind''' was a [[Jedi]] that lived some time prior to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] and developed the technique of [[Force sense/Legends|Force Sense]] as it was taught by the [[New Jedi Order]] under the leadership of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

At some point, a depiction of Trikking came into Skywalker's possession, which he annotated sometime after the Emperor's death in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] along with a copy of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force|The Jedi Path]] and [[Book of Sith]]. The image depicted Trikking during the [[Seventh Assault of the Bone Legion]] at the [[Scouring of Qorl]].
